Basma El Amel Boussaha

Natural Language Processing PhD student

Publications Teaching Blog

I am a PhD student at the University of Nantes,in the TALNteam (an old pic) part of the LS2Nlab. I work on neural conversational systems (chatbots) with deep neural networks under the supervision of Emmanuel Morin, Christine Jacquin and Nicolas Hernandez.
I graduated from Paris-Saclay University in 2016 with a Master CILSand from École Nationale Supérieure d'Informatiquein 2015 with an engineer degree.

Interests: Neural conversational systems, question answering, machine translation, image-text translation, discourse processing, deep learning, reinforcement learning.
